All Implemented Interfaces:

public class DateTypeConverter extends org.apache.struts2.util.StrutsTypeConverter
Struts Date converter, used to convert Dates to Strings (to be used in web forms), and back.

  • Method Details

    • getDateFormatString

      protected String getDateFormatString()
      Returns the format of the String to convert to or be created from a Date. This method should be overridden in child classes that prefer a different date format than the default.
      Returns:
      date format

    • convertFromString

      public Object convertFromString(Map map, String[] values, Class toClass)
      Converts a string in the format of getDateFormatString() to a java.util.Date object. If the value is misformatted, a TypeConversionException is thrown.
      Specified by:
      convertFromString in class org.apache.struts2.util.StrutsTypeConverter
      Parameters:
      map - property map
      values - input string, enclosed in an array
      toClass - type of class expected to be returned
      Returns:
      Date or null if string is null or in an incorrect format
      Throws:
      org.apache.struts2.conversion.TypeConversionException - if any of the values cannot be formatted correctly
      IllegalArgumentException - if toClass is not java.util.Date, or if values contains 0 or more than 1 elements

    • convertToString

      public String convertToString(Map map, Object value)
      Converts a java.util.Date to a String in the format of getDateFormatString().
      Specified by:
      convertToString in class org.apache.struts2.util.StrutsTypeConverter
      Parameters:
      map - property map
      value - value to be converted
      Returns:
      passed date formatted as String
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if value is not of type java.util.Date
